lessons.title: Sounds and the alphabet
lessons.objective: Pronounce Spanish vowels and consonants, spell words aloud, and read written accents.

lessons.title: Hello and goodbye
lessons.objective: Greet people and say goodbye at any time of day, and ask how someone is.

lessons.title: What's your name?
lessons.objective: Introduce yourself and others, and choose between tú and usted.

lessons.title: Ser and where you're from
lessons.objective: Use subject pronouns and ser to say who you are, your nationality, and where you are from.

lessons.title: Nouns and articles
lessons.objective: Use masculine/feminine and singular/plural nouns with el, la, los, las, un, una.

lessons.title: Numbers 0–20 and your age
lessons.objective: Count to twenty and say how old you and others are with tener.

lessons.title: Describing people
lessons.objective: Describe people and things with adjectives that agree in gender and number.

lessons.title: Family and possessives
lessons.objective: Talk about your family using mi, tu, su, nuestro.

lessons.title: Regular -ar verbs
lessons.objective: Conjugate regular -ar verbs in the present to talk about what you do.

lessons.title: Asking questions and saying no
lessons.objective: Ask yes/no and question-word questions and make sentences negative.

lessons.title: Regular -er and -ir verbs
lessons.objective: Conjugate regular -er and -ir verbs in the present.

lessons.title: Estar: where and how
lessons.objective: Use estar for location and temporary states, and start telling ser from estar.

lessons.title: Around town with hay
lessons.objective: Say what there is in a place with hay and talk about places in town.

lessons.title: Big numbers and prices
lessons.objective: Use numbers up to a million and ask and answer how much things cost.

lessons.title: Time and days of the week
lessons.objective: Tell the time and talk about days of the week and daily schedules.

lessons.title: Daily routine
lessons.objective: Describe your daily routine with reflexive verbs.

lessons.title: Stem-changing verbs
lessons.objective: Use present-tense stem-changing verbs (e→ie, o→ue, e→i).

lessons.title: Irregular verbs and ir
lessons.objective: Use common irregular present verbs (ir, hacer, tener, venir, salir, saber, conocer).

lessons.title: Likes and dislikes
lessons.objective: Say what you and others like with gustar and encantar, and agree with también/tampoco.

lessons.title: At the restaurant
lessons.objective: Order food and drinks and talk about what you eat.

lessons.title: Shopping for clothes
lessons.objective: Buy clothes, name colours, and point things out with este, ese, aquel.

lessons.title: Home and prepositions of place
lessons.objective: Describe your home and say where things are.

lessons.title: Weather, months and dates
lessons.objective: Talk about the weather, seasons, months and dates.

lessons.title: Plans with ir a
lessons.objective: Talk about future plans with ir a + infinitive and time expressions.

lessons.title: Can, must and invitations
lessons.objective: Express ability, obligation, and make, accept or turn down invitations.

lessons.title: Direct object pronouns
lessons.objective: Replace direct objects with lo, la, los, las, me, te and use personal a.

lessons.title: What's happening now
lessons.objective: Describe actions in progress with estar + gerund.

lessons.title: Body, health and feelings
lessons.objective: Say how you feel, what hurts, and describe basic emotions.

lessons.title: How often, and connecting ideas
lessons.objective: Say how often you do things and join ideas with y, pero, o, porque, cuando.

lessons.title: Instructions and directions
lessons.objective: Give instructions and directions with the tú imperative.

lessons.title: The preterite: -ar verbs
lessons.objective: Talk about completed past actions with regular -ar verbs in the preterite.

lessons.title: The preterite: -er and -ir verbs
lessons.objective: Use regular -er/-ir verbs in the preterite, including spelling changes.

lessons.title: Irregular preterites
lessons.objective: Use the most common irregular preterites (ser, ir, hacer, tener, estar, poder, decir...).

lessons.title: Telling what happened
lessons.objective: Use stem-changing preterites and sequence a story with primero, luego, después.

lessons.title: The imperfect: how things used to be
lessons.objective: Form the imperfect and talk about past habits.

lessons.title: Describing the past
lessons.objective: Use the imperfect to describe people, places and situations in the past.

lessons.title: Preterite or imperfect? (1)
lessons.objective: Choose between the preterite and the imperfect for events vs. background.

lessons.title: Preterite or imperfect? (2)
lessons.objective: Narrate complete stories mixing the preterite and imperfect.

lessons.title: The present perfect
lessons.objective: Use the present perfect with ya, todavía no, alguna vez, nunca, and irregular participles.

lessons.title: Indirect object pronouns
lessons.objective: Use le and les with verbs like dar, decir and mandar, including doubling.

lessons.title: Double object pronouns
lessons.objective: Combine indirect and direct object pronouns (se lo, me la) in the right position.

lessons.title: Comparing things
lessons.objective: Compare people and things and use the superlative.

lessons.title: Mine, yours, and ordinal numbers
lessons.objective: Use stressed possessives (mío, tuyo) and ordinal numbers.

lessons.title: Something, nothing, someone, no one
lessons.objective: Use indefinite and negative words and double negation.

lessons.title: Travel and transport
lessons.objective: Buy tickets, book a hotel and solve travel problems.

lessons.title: Formal and irregular commands
lessons.objective: Give commands with usted/ustedes and irregular tú commands, with pronouns attached.

lessons.title: Por and para
lessons.objective: Choose between por and para in their most common uses.

lessons.title: Starting, stopping and repeating
lessons.objective: Use verb phrases like acabar de, empezar a, volver a, dejar de and seguir + gerund.

lessons.title: How long? Hace, desde, llevar
lessons.objective: Say how long something has been happening and how long ago something happened.

lessons.title: Shopping and money
lessons.objective: Shop, ask about sizes, return things and handle money.

lessons.title: At the doctor
lessons.objective: Describe symptoms and give and follow health advice.

lessons.title: Character and appearance
lessons.objective: Describe character and appearance, and adjectives that change with ser and estar.

lessons.title: Work and professions
lessons.objective: Talk about jobs and workplaces using que and donde relative clauses.

lessons.title: The future tense
lessons.objective: Make predictions and talk about the future with the simple future.

lessons.title: Would: the conditional
lessons.objective: Be polite, give advice and express wishes with the conditional.

lessons.title: Social occasions
lessons.objective: Apologise, congratulate, give good wishes and condolences, and make a toast.

lessons.title: On the phone and making plans
lessons.objective: Handle phone calls, leave messages and arrange to meet.

lessons.title: Housework and impersonal se
lessons.objective: Talk about chores and general rules with impersonal se.

lessons.title: Preferences and feelings
lessons.objective: Express preferences and how things make you feel (preferir, interesar, molestar).

lessons.title: Giving opinions
lessons.objective: Give opinions and agree or disagree (creo que, me parece que, estoy de acuerdo).

lessons.title: Nature and the environment
lessons.objective: Talk about the countryside, the city, animals and the environment.

lessons.title: Cooking and recipes
lessons.objective: Follow and give recipes with quantities and instructions.

lessons.title: The present subjunctive: regular forms
lessons.objective: Form the present subjunctive of regular verbs.

lessons.title: The present subjunctive: irregular forms
lessons.objective: Form the irregular present subjunctive (ser, ir, estar, dar, saber, haber, stem changes).

lessons.title: Hopes and wishes
lessons.objective: Express wishes with ojalá, querer que and esperar que.

lessons.title: Asking, advising and forbidding
lessons.objective: Influence others with recomendar que, pedir que, prohibir que and negative commands.

lessons.title: Feelings about things
lessons.objective: React emotionally with me alegra que, me molesta que, tengo miedo de que.

lessons.title: Judging things: es importante que
lessons.objective: Make value judgments with es importante que + subjunctive vs. es verdad que + indicative.

lessons.title: Doubt and certainty
lessons.objective: Express doubt and certainty (dudo que, no creo que, quizás, a lo mejor).

lessons.title: When it happens: time clauses
lessons.objective: Use cuando, hasta que, antes de que, después de que with the right mood.

lessons.title: Purpose: para que
lessons.objective: Express purpose with para + infinitive and para que + subjunctive; por vs. para again.

lessons.title: Relative clauses and mood
lessons.objective: Describe known and unknown things with relative clauses (busco a alguien que hable...).

lessons.title: The pluperfect
lessons.objective: Say what had happened before another past event.

lessons.title: Guessing: future of probability
lessons.objective: Make guesses about the present with the future tense.

lessons.title: The conditional in depth
lessons.objective: Use the conditional for past probability, hypotheses and advice.

lessons.title: The imperfect subjunctive
lessons.objective: Form the imperfect subjunctive (-ra, and recognise -se).

lessons.title: If: real and hypothetical conditions
lessons.objective: Use si-clauses for real and hypothetical conditions.

lessons.title: Wishes and requests in the past
lessons.objective: Use the imperfect subjunctive after past triggers (quería que, me pidió que).

lessons.title: The present perfect subjunctive
lessons.objective: Use the present perfect subjunctive (espero que hayas llegado bien).

lessons.title: Reported speech: statements
lessons.objective: Report what someone said, shifting tenses correctly.

lessons.title: Reported speech: questions and commands
lessons.objective: Report questions (me preguntó si...) and commands (me dijo que viniera).

lessons.title: The many uses of se
lessons.objective: Use reciprocal se, passive/impersonal se and accidental se (se me olvidó).

lessons.title: Linking ideas
lessons.objective: Connect ideas with sin embargo, aunque, además, por lo tanto, así que, ya que, como.

lessons.title: Adverbs and intensifiers
lessons.objective: Form adverbs with -mente and use -ísimo, solo and sobre todo.

lessons.title: Habits and processes
lessons.objective: Use soler, ponerse a, estar a punto de, llevar + gerund.

lessons.title: Qué or cuál? Exclamations
lessons.objective: Choose qué vs. cuál and make exclamations (¡Qué día tan bonito!).

lessons.title: Lo and lo que
lessons.objective: Use neuter lo and lo que to talk about ideas.

lessons.title: Empathy, regret and reactions
lessons.objective: Show empathy, express regret and react to news.

lessons.title: Arguing your point
lessons.objective: Structure an argument and take a position for or against.

lessons.title: The world of work
lessons.objective: Handle job interviews and write formal emails.

lessons.title: News and the passive voice
lessons.objective: Understand news headlines and the passive with ser + participle.

lessons.title: Healthy living
lessons.objective: Talk about lifestyle and health using subjunctive advice.

lessons.title: Telling anecdotes
lessons.objective: Tell a full story using all past tenses together.

lessons.title: Technology and the internet
lessons.objective: Talk about devices, the internet and social media.

lessons.title: Relationships and personality
lessons.objective: Talk about relationships and adjectives that change meaning with ser/estar.

lessons.title: Verbs of change
lessons.objective: Express change with ponerse, volverse, hacerse, quedarse and convertirse en.

lessons.title: Festivals and regional Spanish
lessons.objective: Learn about Latin American festivals and recognise vosotros and voseo.

lessons.title: Society and the environment
lessons.objective: Discuss problems and propose solutions.

lessons.title: Indicative or subjunctive? The big picture
lessons.objective: Decide between indicative and subjunctive across all the main triggers.

lessons.title: Although: concessive clauses
lessons.objective: Use aunque, a pesar de (que), por mucho que with indicative or subjunctive.

lessons.title: As soon as: advanced time clauses
lessons.objective: Use en cuanto, tan pronto como, apenas, una vez que, mientras.

lessons.title: If only I had known: past unreal
lessons.objective: Use the pluperfect subjunctive for past unreal conditions and regrets.

lessons.title: Will have, would have
lessons.objective: Use the future perfect and conditional perfect, including for probability.

lessons.title: Provided that, unless, in case
lessons.objective: Express conditions with con tal de que, a menos que, siempre que, en caso de que, de + infinitive.

lessons.title: As if
lessons.objective: Use como si with the imperfect and pluperfect subjunctive.

lessons.title: Relative pronouns: el cual, cuyo
lessons.objective: Use el que, el cual, lo cual, quien and cuyo; restrictive vs. non-restrictive clauses.

lessons.title: Relative clauses with prepositions
lessons.objective: Build relative clauses with prepositions (con la que, en el que).

lessons.title: Sequence of tenses
lessons.objective: Match tenses correctly between main and subordinate clauses.

lessons.title: Reporting verbs
lessons.objective: Report speech with verbs like asegurar, negar, sugerir, advertir.

lessons.title: The passive voice
lessons.objective: Use the passive with ser, estar + participle, and passive se.

lessons.title: It's not that...
lessons.objective: Use subjunctive after negated opinion and communication verbs, and no es que.

lessons.title: Cause and consequence
lessons.objective: Express cause and consequence (puesto que, dado que, de modo que, tan... que).

lessons.title: More verb phrases
lessons.objective: Use llegar a, acabar + gerund, ir + gerund, andar + gerund, llevar/tener + participle, deber de.

lessons.title: The good thing is...: nominalisation
lessons.objective: Use lo + adjective, lo + adjective + que, and el hecho de que.

lessons.title: Verbs that change with se
lessons.objective: Use pronominal verbs that change meaning (ir/irse, llevar/llevarse) and the dative of interest.

lessons.title: Discourse markers
lessons.objective: Use no obstante, en cambio, es decir, de hecho, en resumen, en cualquier caso.

lessons.title: Verbs with prepositions
lessons.objective: Use verbs with fixed prepositions (depender de, soñar con, consistir en).

lessons.title: Ser and estar: advanced
lessons.objective: Master ser/estar contrasts that change meaning and estar de, ser + location of events.

lessons.title: Building words
lessons.objective: Use prefixes and suffixes, diminutives and augmentatives.

lessons.title: Debating
lessons.objective: Argue, concede, counter-argue and hedge in a debate.

lessons.title: Formal writing
lessons.objective: Write formal letters, complaints and reports in the right register.

lessons.title: Work and the economy
lessons.objective: Discuss business, the economy and working conditions.

lessons.title: Science and hypotheses
lessons.objective: Discuss science and technology and express hypotheses (puede que, es posible que).

lessons.title: Politics and society
lessons.objective: Discuss politics and social issues.

lessons.title: Everyday idioms
lessons.objective: Understand and use common Latin American idioms.

lessons.title: Regrets and reproaches
lessons.objective: Express regret and reproach (ojalá hubiera, deberías haber).

lessons.title: Health, medicine and accents
lessons.objective: Discuss medicine and master written accent rules.

lessons.title: Books, films and the arts
lessons.objective: Describe and review books, films and art.

lessons.title: Quantifiers
lessons.objective: Use cualquier(a), cada, varios, ambos, demás, fractions and multiples.

lessons.title: Commands with nuance
lessons.objective: Soften and strengthen commands and use que + subjunctive wishes and set phrases (anda, venga).

lessons.title: Numbers, trends and graphs
lessons.objective: Describe statistics, trends and graphs.

lessons.title: Spanish across countries
lessons.objective: Recognise voseo and vocabulary differences between Spanish-speaking countries.

lessons.title: When mood changes meaning
lessons.objective: Use verbs whose meaning changes with indicative or subjunctive (decir, sentir, comprender).

lessons.title: Advanced concessives
lessons.objective: Use por más que, si bien, aun + gerund, y eso que, así.

lessons.title: Advanced conditions
lessons.objective: Use de + compound infinitive, como + subjunctive, a no ser que, salvo que, siempre y cuando.

lessons.title: Advanced relative clauses
lessons.objective: Use cuyo, lo cual, el cual, quienquiera, and free relatives.

lessons.title: Advanced purpose
lessons.objective: Express purpose with a fin de que, con el objeto de, no sea que.

lessons.title: So... that: intensive consequence
lessons.objective: Use tan... que, tal... que, de tal modo que, de ahí que.

lessons.title: As, while, upon: advanced time
lessons.objective: Use a medida que, conforme, según, tras, nada más + infinitive.

lessons.title: Gerunds and absolute participles
lessons.objective: Use gerunds with causal/conditional/concessive meaning and absolute participle clauses.

lessons.title: Expressive verb phrases
lessons.objective: Use echarse a, romper a, acabar por, venir + gerund, quedar en, dar por.

lessons.title: Stylistic uses of tenses
lessons.objective: Recognise and use the historical present, imperfect of politeness, rumour conditional, and future of concession.

lessons.title: Pronouns at an advanced level
lessons.objective: Handle ello, clitic doubling, and recognise leísmo, laísmo and loísmo.

lessons.title: Emphasis and word order
lessons.objective: Use cleft sentences (es ahí donde, fue él quien) and topicalisation for emphasis.

lessons.title: Advanced discourse markers
lessons.objective: Use ahora bien, con todo, a fin de cuentas, dicho sea de paso, en definitiva.

lessons.title: Academic and formal register
lessons.objective: Write in an academic register with impersonal structures and hedging.

lessons.title: Colloquial Spanish
lessons.objective: Understand informal Latin American colloquialisms by region.

lessons.title: Idioms and proverbs
lessons.objective: Understand and use idioms and proverbs.

lessons.title: Collocations
lessons.objective: Use natural verb + noun combinations (tomar una decisión, dar un paseo).

lessons.title: Near-synonyms
lessons.objective: Choose between near-synonyms (mirar/ver/observar, pedir/preguntar, quedar/quedarse).

lessons.title: False friends
lessons.objective: Avoid false friends and anglicisms (embarazada, realizar, actualmente).

lessons.title: Advanced prepositional verbs
lessons.objective: Use verbs with fixed prepositions (atreverse a, carecer de, empeñarse en).

lessons.title: Mood in special contexts
lessons.objective: Choose mood after superlatives, el único que, and in free relatives.

lessons.title: Reporting with nuance
lessons.objective: Report speech with nuanced verbs (alegar, insinuar, reconocer) and summarise.

lessons.title: Persuasion and rhetoric
lessons.objective: Persuade using rhetorical questions, irony and emphasis.

lessons.title: Business and meetings
lessons.objective: Take part in formal meetings and business negotiations.

lessons.title: Law, rights and institutions
lessons.objective: Discuss law, rights and institutions.

lessons.title: Abstract and scientific topics
lessons.objective: Discuss abstract, philosophical and scientific topics.

lessons.title: Reading literature
lessons.objective: Read literary Spanish and recognise literary and legal forms (future subjunctive).

lessons.title: Humour and wordplay
lessons.objective: Understand humour, wordplay and double meanings.

lessons.title: Accents and spelling mastery
lessons.objective: Recognise regional accents and apply current spelling norms.

lessons.title: Politeness and nuance
lessons.objective: Soften requests and criticism and handle delicate situations.
